name: Dire Wolf
freeText:
Lupine Senses
Type: Passive
Classification: Utility / Detection
Domain: Wolf Species
Description:
As a wolf (or wolf-like creature, e.g., Hunter pet, Worgen in form, or custom wolf race), your senses are honed to predatory perfection, excelling at scent detection and awareness. This skill is species-restricted: Only available to wolf entities (GM approval for hybrids like Worgen or Druid forms; not for non-wolf races without narrative justification).
Passive Effect: Gain +[listed bonus] to Passive Perception (10 + Spi mod + bonus) and all Survival checks involving scent (tracking trails, detecting hidden/invisible creatures by odor, poisons/gases).
Current F Rank: +3

Pack Pounce
Type: Active (1 Action)
Classification: Combat
Domain: Wolf Species
Description:
As a wolf (or wolf-like creature, e.g., Hunter pet, Worgen in form, or custom wolf race), you coil and launch in a ferocious pounce, leaping to tackle a target. Leap up to [listed range] ft in a straight line (ignoring difficult terrain; must end adjacent to target). Make a melee weapon attack (d20 + Agi mod vs. target's Dodge Rating) using your natural bite/claws (base 1d8 non-magical damage). This skill is species-restricted: Only available to wolf entities (GM approval for hybrids like Worgen or Druid forms; not for non-wolf races without narrative justification).
On a hit, deal the rolled amount from the listed damage dice as additional non-magical damage.
Current F Rank: 3D6 at 15 ft range

Alpha Bite
Type: Active (1 Action)
Classification: Combat
Domain: Wolf Species
Description:
As a wolf (or wolf-like creature, e.g., Hunter pet, Worgen in form, or custom wolf race), you lunge forward and sink your fangs into a target within range. Make a melee weapon attack (d20 + Agi mod vs. target's Dodge Rating) using your natural bite (base 1d6 non-magical damage). This skill is species-restricted: Only available to wolf entities (GM approval for hybrids like Worgen or Druid forms; not for non-wolf races without narrative justification).
On a hit, deal the rolled amount from the listed damage dice as additional non-magical damage.
Secondary Effect: The target must succeed on a Stamina saving throw (DC = 10 + Str mod) or be Knocked Prone (falls to the ground, granting advantage to melee attacks against it until it stands).
Range: Melee (5 ft)
Current F Rank: 2D6

Lupine Prowl
Type: Passive
Classification: Utility
Domain: Wolf Species
Description:
As a wolf (or wolf-like creature, e.g., Hunter pet, Worgen in form, or custom wolf race), you embody the silent predator's grace, enhancing your natural stealth and predatory instincts. This skill is species-restricted: Only available to wolf entities (GM approval for hybrids like Worgen or Druid forms; not for non-wolf races without narrative justification, e.g., polymorph or evolution).
Passive Effect: Gain +[listed bonus] to all Stealth checks (d20 + Agi mod + bonus) and Initiative rolls in natural environments (e.g., Elwynn Forest, woods near Northshire).
Current F Rank: +3
